name: Fashion Nova

outcome.note: Store credit as a Fashion Nova gift card.

requirement.note: From the existing Fashion Nova reference in the app.

conditions.value: Unworn, unwashed, with original tags, within 30 days of delivery. Refunds are store credit. Bodysuits, swimwear, undergarments, beauty products and accessories can't be returned.

processing.value: 5–7 business days after the return reaches Fashion Nova

categories.label: Damaged or wrong items
categories.conditions: Contact customer care within 14 days of delivery.
categories.note: Refunded to the original payment method instead of store credit.

value.without: Returns are started online in the returns portal.

timing.value: 5–7 business days after the return reaches Fashion Nova

methods.label: Mail it back
steps: Open returns.fashionnova.com and start a return with your order number
Pack the item with its tags and send it
methods.note: In-store returns aren't available for online orders, and exchanges aren't offered by mail.

unknowns.note: Fashion Nova pages disagree on which price endings (.48, .96, .97, .98, .00) mark final sale.
The window is extended in the holiday season; the dates aren't published yet.

research: Started from the app's Fashion Nova reference (researched 2026-10-08). Re-checked against official US pages through web-search excerpts on 2026-10-11 (direct page downloads were blocked from the build environment). Spot-check before launch.
